mapper.sql: o.oppt_id,o.oppt_no,o.oppt_nm,o.cust_ptnr_id,o.bsn_part_id,o.bsn_chrg_user_id AS owner_user_id, o.bsn_stg_cd,o.win_prblt_rt,o.expc_amt,o.cntrct_ty_cd,o.expc_bgn_ym AS bgn_ym,o.expc_mnth_qty AS mth_cnt, o.next_work_desc AS next_action,o.next_work_ddln_dt AS next_action_dt,o.rmrk_desc,o.amount_difference_reason, o.oppt_stts_cd,o.win_prj_id,o.updated_at,o.created_at,o.quot_aprv_stts_cd AS approval_state, o.expc_sls_amt,o.expc_cst_amt,o.expc_mrgn_rt,o.aprv_mrgn_rt,o.zero_cost_evidence,o.zero_cost_validation
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bsn.oppt o ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM bsn.oppt o ORDER BY o.oppt_id
SELECT FROM bsn.oppt o WHERE o.oppt_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM bsn.oppt o WHERE o.oppt_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT need_id,job_cd,grd_cd,psn_cnt,bgn_ym,mnth_qty AS mth_cnt,mth_mm_qty, coalesce(expc_untprc_amt,0) AS expc_untprc_amt,rmrk_desc,coalesce(psn_mth_cst_amt,0) AS psn_mth_cst_amt, coalesce(min_untprc_amt,0) AS min_untprc_amt,coalesce(trgt_untprc_amt,0) AS trgt_untprc_amt FROM bsn.oppt_need WHERE oppt_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,need_id

SELECT aprv_prcs_cd AS action,opnn_desc AS opinion,prcs_user_id AS user_id,prcs_at AS created_at,mrgn_rt AS expc_mrgn_rt FROM bsn.quot_aprv_hist WHERE oppt_id=#{id} ORDER BY prcs_at DESC,aprv_hist_id DESC

SELECT d.dev_id,d.main_job_cd AS job_cd,d.grd_cd,c.mth_cst_id,c.cst_ym, CAST(c.indv_lbr_cst_amt AS numeric)+coalesce((SELECT sum(e.expns_amt) FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.dev_id=d.dev_id AND e.expns_ym=c.cst_ym),0) AS amount FROM mst.dev d JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.mth_cst_id,m.cst_ym,m.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst m WHERE m.dev_id=d.dev_id AND m.cst_ym<=to_char(#{today},'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY m.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt>#{today}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt<=#{today} AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt>=#{today})) ORDER BY d.dev_id
SELECT num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN attr1_val ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN CAST(attr1_val AS bigint) ELSE NULL END FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id='JOB' AND dtl_cd=#{job} AND use_yn='Y'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN ('CUST','BOTH'))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bsn.oppt(oppt_id,oppt_no,oppt_nm,cust_ptnr_id,bsn_part_id,bsn_chrg_user_id,bsn_stg_cd,win_prblt_rt,expc_amt,cntrct_ty_cd,expc_bgn_ym,expc_mnth_qty,next_work_desc,next_work_ddln_dt,rmrk_desc,amount_difference_reason,oppt_stts_cd,quot_aprv_stts_cd,expc_sls_amt,expc_cst_amt,expc_mrgn_rt,created_by) VALUES(#{id},'O-'||CASE WHEN #{id}<10 THEN '0'||CAST(#{id} AS text) ELSE CAST(#{id} AS text) END,#{input.oppt_nm},#{input.cust_ptnr_id},#{input.bsn_part_id},#{input.owner_user_id},#{input.bsn_stg_cd},#{probability},#{input.expc_amt},#{input.cntrct_ty_cd},#{input.bgn_ym},#{input.mth_cnt},#{input.next_action},#{input.next_action_dt},#{input.rmrk_desc},#{input.amount_difference_reason},'OPEN',#{quote.approval_state},#{quote.expc_sls_amt},#{quote.expc_cst_amt},#{quote.expc_mrgn_rt},#{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE bsn.oppt SET oppt_nm=#{input.oppt_nm},cust_ptnr_id=#{input.cust_ptnr_id},bsn_part_id=#{input.bsn_part_id},bsn_chrg_user_id=#{input.owner_user_id},bsn_stg_cd=#{input.bsn_stg_cd},win_prblt_rt=#{probability},expc_amt=#{input.expc_amt},cntrct_ty_cd=#{input.cntrct_ty_cd},expc_bgn_ym=#{input.bgn_ym},expc_mnth_qty=#{input.mth_cnt},next_work_desc=#{input.next_action},next_work_ddln_dt=#{input.next_action_dt},rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc},amount_difference_reason=#{input.amount_difference_reason},quot_aprv_stts_cd=#{quote.approval_state},expc_sls_amt=#{quote.expc_sls_amt},expc_cst_amt=#{quote.expc_cst_amt},expc_mrgn_rt=#{quote.expc_mrgn_rt},updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ,aprv_mrgn_rt=NULL,aprv_user_id=NULL,aprv_at=NULL,zero_cost_evidence=NULL,zero_cost_validation=NULL,rjct_rsn_desc=NULL WHERE oppt_id=#{id} AND oppt_stts_cd='OPEN'

UPDATE bsn.oppt_need SET job_cd=#{input.job_cd},grd_cd=#{input.grd_cd},psn_cnt=#{input.psn_cnt},bgn_ym=#{input.bgn_ym},mnth_qty=#{input.mth_cnt},mth_mm_qty=#{input.mth_mm_qty},expc_untprc_amt=#{input.expc_untprc_amt},psn_mth_cst_amt=#{cost},min_untprc_amt=#{cost},trgt_untprc_amt=#{target},sort_seq=#{sequence},rmrk_desc=#{input.rmrk_desc},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE need_id=#{needId} AND oppt_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y'
UPDATE asgn.tmpr_asgn SET tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='RELEASED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE need_id=#{id} AND tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
UPDATE bsn.oppt_need SET use_yn='N',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE need_id=#{id}
